faq.q: What is an AI game icon generator?
faq.a: An AI game icon generator creates game-ready icons from text descriptions or reference images, including inventory items, skills, weapons, abilities, and UI icons.

faq.q: Can I generate multiple game icons at once?
faq.a: Yes. SpritePixel generates up to 9 icons together on one 3×3 image so the complete set shares one visual style.

faq.q: How does retry work for an icon set?
faq.a: Retry regenerates the complete 3×3 sheet as one image, preserving the shared style and layout.

faq.q: What types of game icons can I create?
faq.a: You can create inventory icons, skill icons, item icons, weapon icons, ability icons, status icons, and other game UI assets.

faq.q: Can I create pixel art game icons?
faq.a: Yes. Pixel Art is one of the available styles, along with Hand-painted RPG, Cartoon, Anime, Dark Fantasy, and Cyberpunk.

faq.q: Can I use a reference image?
faq.a: Yes. You can upload a reference image to help maintain a specific visual style across your generated icons.
You can generate game icons for common sizes such as 64×64, 128×128, and 256×256.

faq.q: How do I download the generated icons?
faq.a: Download the complete transparent 3×3 icon sheet as one PNG.

faq.q: Can I generate game props with the AI Game Icon Generator?
faq.a: Yes. You can generate isolated objects such as crates, weapons, potions, furniture, collectibles, and other game props in addition to traditional UI icons.

faq.q: What's the difference between a game icon and a game prop?
faq.a: Game icons are usually designed for inventories, skills, and UI, while props are objects that may appear directly in the game world. SpritePixel can generate both using the same consistent style.
